location: Lô 11 – Thửa D14, Khu tái định cư Bắc Sông Cấm, xã Dương Quan, huyện Thủy Nguyên, TP. Hải Phòng
content: Diamond Bvlgarvia is envisioned as a contemporary high-rise residential development integrating living spaces, retail, and amenities into a cohesive whole. The project aims to establish a progressive residential community with a high-quality living environment that balances urban convenience, green landscapes, and commercial potential. With people at its core, the development is designed to deliver a contemporary living experience through a diverse range of amenities, open spaces, and convenient connectivity, helping create a new architectural landmark in the Bắc Sông Cấm urban area.
